summary: Strategy Inc filed an 8-K on May 26, 2026, providing routine updates under Items 7.01 and 8.01. It reported no ATM share sales or bitcoin purchases between May 18-25, 2026, holding ~843,738 bitcoin acquired at an aggregate ~$63.87B (~$75,700/bitcoin avg). The USD Reserve balance was $871M as of May 25, 2026. A press release on capital structure updates was furnished. This is a periodic status update, not a special situation. No special-situation event occurred.
